credential_profile.name: printable-ascii
credential_profile.unknown: Not a complete ACP/IME encoder; non-ASCII rejected.

browser_transport.optional: WebSocket constructor for platform tests; browser default is native WebSocket
browser_transport.endpoints: explicit1..10 numeric127.0.0.1 address/port pairs, copied before use; selected endpoint must be in list
browser_transport.ownership: input views are copied before send; reads return owned nonempty Uint8Array; late/stale/cancelled data not applied
browser_transport.backpressure: one pending read and one pending write; writes await bridge TCP write completion acknowledgement, not peer authentication
browser_transport.end: explicit EOF drains queued bytes then read returns null; unexpected close/invalid control is a controlled failure; cancel rejects pending operations and closes WebSocket

loopback_bridge.bind: 127.0.0.1 only, default ephemeral port; CLI default4174; no default target or gameCode
loopback_bridge.http: GET only; exact Host and browser Sec-Fetch-Site policy; root302 canonicalizes/web/login.html; source whitelist web/shared and suffix html/css/mjs/js/svg; no symlinks, original binaries, analysis or upload
loopback_bridge.runtime: same-origin /runtime.json provides copied endpoints, slot and fresh process-only random32B capability; no CORS, no persistent token/logging
loopback_bridge.upgrade: exact Host/Origin, /stream, single moli-launcher-v1 subprotocol, at most8 active clients
loopback_bridge.authorization_message: independent local JSON v1 + exact capability + endpointOrdinal; validated before opening TCP; not an official protocol field
loopback_bridge.binary_messages: actual launcher bytes unchanged; no encryption/credential processing in bridge
loopback_bridge.cleanup: normal WebSocket close plus owned TCP abort/close;250ms owned socket termination fallback, server.close tears down only its own ports; no VM/program control
loopback_bridge.snapshot: activeStreams, connectionAttempts, peerEOFs; no payload/capability/account fields

flow: read4 explicitly selected local UTF-8 text files or explicitly choose original test texts
actual WebSocket→TCP exchange using default browser WebCrypto
display4 original profile rows or empty/rejected/cancelled result
explicit supported choice; no IPC/game launch
ui.files: each nonempty≤64KiB UTF-8 fatal decode, NUL rejected, textContent rendering, no file name or content persisted
ui.consent: forcePrompt true, recordedVersion0, native resource slot gameCode+1; unsupported resource slots block review; accept is current-page-only, write intent discarded; no real terms supplied
ui.retention: default mode2 false/false; explicit2→1 confirmation clears both inputs and consent; mode1 starts username true/password false, each user-controlled; no localStorage/sessionStorage/IndexedDB writes
ui.request_counter: independent current-page policy starts0 and increments per constructed session; not evidence of full native counter lifecycle
ui.reset: default password cleared on session construction, default username cleared after attempt; user edits or new text review clear old candidate session, DOM rows and selection; new async reads have generation guards
ui.presentation: ASCII profile names rendered as literal text, other name bytes get bounded unknown-encoding label; never display opaque field/key/private exponent or treat candidates as authenticated

primary_sources.usage: server package options, binary message and upgrade API; browser uses native WebSocket
ANSI API/codepage distinction, not proof of actual sample runtime ACP

not_implemented: official authentication/service identity, real account/password persistence or original applicable terms
catalog/bootstrap integration into session page; source/update trust or native replacement rollback
remote mobile HTTPS/WSS transport, Safari, WeChat mini program and physical devices
authorization: Current static/offline/original-loopback implementation only. No original executable, VM, real account or official game traffic.
